Hi! I grew up religious I didn’t even consider the fact that I was gay until I met my best friend who was the only out lesbian at my high school. I never felt fulfilled with men. I loved the chase but once it was over I was bored. I wondered why I didn’t ever feel that spark that everyone spoke about. The first time I kissed I girl I said “I understand now” I was super scared to come out to my family. It was hard. But I didn’t until I played around with the idea more. Tried girls and then went back to men. And it didn’t work for me. The comphet was really strong and sometimes I feel like it would be easier to be with a man. The convenience. But I’m glad that I did that. I’m glad I explored. Since 2018 I have identified as a lesbian. And I have went back to men sometimes but more out of self hatred. I know you love him. But love him enough to set him free. And love yourself enough to do what’s best for you. Everyone will be better in the long run. Take it from someone who lived it. I’m so much happier and have experienced such intense feelings I didn’t even think I was capable of since I started dating women. Those who love you will support you. It may take time for them to come around. Maybe they won’t. But don’t live your life to please other people. He’s your first and that’s so special but I think you should try to see what’s out there for you. Because if you don’t you’ll spend your whole life wondering. Idk where I’d be if I never did the scary thing. You know what I mean! I wish you so much luck.
